category_title: Defiant and disengaged boys who resist standard classroom requirements
scenario_title: Required written work and missing materials
minimal_context: The student is in class and is expected to complete written work in his reader's notebook.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please take out your reader's notebooks and begin your written work for today.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Continues reading the book Monster) I'm just reading.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: The reader's notebook is a key part of our class. You need to do the writing.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Reading Monster is the only work I'm doing.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: I need to ask you about your reader's notebook. Where is it?

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Please take out your reader's notebooks and begin your written work for today.

STUDENT: (Continues reading the book Monster) I'm just reading.

TUTOR: The reader's notebook is a key part of our class. You need to do the writing.

STUDENT: Reading Monster is the only work I'm doing.

TUTOR: I need to ask you about your reader's notebook. Where is it?

STUDENT: I forgot to bring it.

task.content: Reader's notebooks were a key part of our class

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When I asked Jayson about his reader's notebook
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: he said he forgot to bring it

behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: reading Monster was the only work he did
